item.title: Version 0.8.3
item.description:
Fixed

  • Fix crash on launch for users with duplicate records. A startup crash that hit users whose local store contained a duplicate campaign, ad group, or keyword is now fixed. The app opens cleanly and shows every row instead of bailing out.
  • Revenue figures stop leaking across the date filter. Switching between Today and Yesterday quickly could briefly show one range’s per-campaign RC Revenue while the other was loading — most visibly as the same number on both views. The revenue lookup now resets on actual range changes and ignores in-flight data that arrives after you’ve moved on.
  • Yesterday filter now covers a full 24-hour day. Previously the Yesterday range was a zero-width instant, so totals computed against your local store returned nothing. Fixed.
  • Revenue and spend now use the same timezone. Revenue queries used the device’s local timezone while spend used your org’s reporting timezone. They now agree, so the two columns can’t disagree on which day a number belongs to for users whose device and org timezones differ.
